en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses. People walk and horse‑drawn carts stand in the street. In the background there is a prominent tower with a clock and a spire. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Ronneburg and the street as Schlossstrasse. At the lower left the publisher credit reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen." On the right-hand building a shop sign with the name "Hermann Kretsch…" is partially visible.
